description: CBE Clima Tool is published by Center for the Built Environment. It describes a free web application that reads EPW weather files and presents climate variables and derived building-design metrics. Its scope is generic model use; applicability and spatial or temporal resolution depend on the supplied case and inputs. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Documented interfaces include Web GUI. Software was not installed or executed. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article is CC-BY-SA-4.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The authors report use by practitioners and students in more than 70 countries. The paper establishes wider use; this session did not run the application. This review identifies optimisation, capacity planning as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
